page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Margin note in the right margin, beside "objicient,". Signature at the foot, right of centre. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right.

main_text.l: ferentiæ si[?] referatur ad objectu, nempe pro in-
differentia objectiva judicii proponentis objectū,
quod nempe voluntas velle vel nolle poteft, pro
sua natura quippe quia non magis læderetur es-
sentia libertatis, si libertas hoc potius quā illud
amplecteretur, tum facile solveretur quæstio:
sed quia difficile est cum protervis adversariis
limites quæstionis figere, quo fata disputatio-
nis nos ducant, sequi & persequi hostes opor-
tet.
At contra hanc indifferentiam objicient,
talem indifferentiam competere causæ natura-
li, nam non-calefactio non magis lædit essen-
tiam & actum primum ignis, quam calefac-
tio. Sed respondeo, quamvis in casu mira-
culi salvetur essentia ignis sub non-calefactio-
ne, non tamen salvatur naturalis modus agen-
di in igne. At nec actus primus, nec actus secun-
dus potentiæ liberæ lædituer, sive voluntas hoc
velit, sive non. Dabimus itaque duplicem in-
differentiam in potentia liberâ, aliam objecti-
vam, nempe quando intellectus proponit eli-
gibile libertati ut medium summo bono abso-
lutè intento non necessarium, aliam internam,
vitalem, electivam, qua voluntas libera ex se
poteft tam hoc velle, quam nolle, salva tum
essentia libertatis, tum salvo naturalissimo a-
gendi modo suo.
9. Hinc prima nostra assertio. Voluntati
liberæ in se & formaliter convenit indifferen-
tia hæc & objectiva & interna, & per hanc à
non coactione, à spontaneitate, & ab omnibus
causis naturalibus formaliter distinguitur.

marginalia.note: Vide Remonstr. in apolog. exam. cens. ap. 7. fol. 81.

page.notes: The left margin carries only the printed rule line and no text. The margin note beside "objicient," is set in small type over several lines; its wording is read partly by reconstruction and the abbreviations "cens." and "ap." are doubtful. The word "lædituer" is as printed; it may be a misprint for "lædituer" or "læditur". The first word of the page "ferentiæ" continues a word from the previous page; the initial letter of the "si" sign is doubtful. Catchword "liber-" and signature "A 5" are at the foot.
